scoring_justification: Recomputing the exchange constants from DFT raw energies requires re-running DFT calculations, which is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. Therefore, the checker compares the agent's reported J values to the hidden published DFT values with sign and tolerance checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold exchange constants J1–J4 from DFT (Table 2)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2, DFT row for complex 1
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values taken directly from the published paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the paper's actual reported results for the same computational protocol.

J1.description: Exchange coupling constant J1 in cm⁻¹

J2.description: Exchange coupling constant J2 in cm⁻¹

J3.description: Exchange coupling constant J3 in cm⁻¹

J4.description: Exchange coupling constant J4 in cm⁻¹

outputs.description: Exchange coupling constants J1–J4 for the target heterometallic wheel obtained from broken-symmetry DFT, in cm⁻¹. Compared to hidden reference values from the published DFT calculations.

output_contract.notes: The hidden reference corresponds to the DFT-computed values for the Ni-containing wheel reported in the original study. Units are cm⁻¹ and the sign convention follows −2∑J_ij S_i·S_j.
